main_body: three-story brick campus building with flat concrete roof
top_band: light grey tiled flat roof with parapet and rooftop vents, rows 1-40
evidence: Rows 1-40 show the foreshortened flat roof from above, complete with parapet inner shadows (rows 3-5), tiled concrete surface (rows 6-37), and front parapet edge (rows 38-40). Rows 41-46 show the cream cornice with overhanging dentil shadow at row 44-46. Rows 47-143 show the three-story brick south facade with recessed windows (dark inner shadow along top/left of glass) and recessed arched double doors.

style.evidence: Materials use 4-5 distinct value steps (brick wall has highlight, mid-red, dark red, deep brown mortar/shadow; cream stone trim has 4 steps; roof tiles have 4-5 grey steps with speckle). Outlines and separations use dark material tones (deep brown on brick, dark grey on roof, dark slate on doors). Roof slabs have speckle texture, bricks are individually shaded, windows have diagonal reflection highlights, matching the Beodeul reference density.
